title: KIDS SEE GHOSTS
description: The image is based on Katsushika Hokusai's swastika Fuji. Visual elements observed in both artworks include the backdrop of Mount Fuji, Murakami's Oval Characters that are painted atop the other as well as a pair of bending trees. The positioning of these elements in each piece remains the same except for the Oval characters in Kids being minimized and placed more to the left. The most fascinating component is the inverted Kanji characters in Kids that translates to "Chaos."

title: 🏆 Living So Italian [V1]
description: Listed on an early Watch The Throne tracklist given out by music insider blog The DOTR. Fully finished with a hook and verse from Ye, alongside a JAŸ-Z verse later reused on "Fuckwitmeyouknowigotit" from his album Magna Carta... Holy Grail. According to Aziz Ansari, "We were sitting there, and we were watching some basketball game or something... Jay Z’s just kind of staring off, and he just taps Kanye, and he very quickly whispers this rap, It was one of the raps in the song and he had just come up with it, and it was long and so complicated". Samples "Por Ti Volare" by Andrea Bocelli, which could not be cleared, being the reason it was cut. The beat was originally given to Lil B for his song "New York Subway", and was later brought to Watch The Throne sessions by Karlyle. One of the holy grails of unreleased Ye tracks. LQ snippet leaked May 2019. Three more LQ snippets of Kanye's verse leaked before it leaked in full LQ on November 13th, 2023. Lossless snippets leaked on September 21st, 2026.

description: The Yeezy Quantum 'Quantum' represents Kanye West’s debut sneaker in the basketball space. This lifestyle edition features a knit upper with wavy cut-out strips that reveal a breathable mesh base underneath. The grey and white tones used on both layers are complemented by reflective accents, an Off-White suede toe cap and solid black hits at the collar, tongue and heel. The mid-top is supported by a Boost midsole and a herringbone-tread rubber outsole.

title: YS-02 (YEEZY SLIDE 2)
description:
Background: Designed by Christophe De Roy and Kelsey Foo, the YS-02 is a continuation of the Yeezy Gap Engineered by Balenciaga Bulb Slide. After the termination of Yeezy Gap, Ye dropped the project, but picked it back up in 2025, where he would be seen wearing them on 02/19/2026 at dinner with Bianca Censori in Los Angeles.

The slide features a slimmer base compared to the YS-01/Original Yeezy Slide and a Bulb shape upper. It is very slightly less comfortable than the YS-01.

On 07/14/2026, an image of a rack of Yeezy samples leaked, showing a white colorway of the YS-02.
